faq.question: Q1. What is NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive conducted by NTPC Limited for experienced professionals for Deputy Manager posts in Electrical, Mechanical and C&I disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 135 Deputy Manager vacancies are available.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts available in NTPC Deputy Manager Vacancy 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Deputy Manager (Electrical), Deputy Manager (Mechanical) and Deputy Manager (C&I).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have the required engineering qualification in the relevant discipline along with the experience criteria mentioned in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of NTPC Deputy Manager posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed in E4 grade with IDA pay scale of ₹70,000 - ₹2,00,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 26 August 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for NTPC Deputy Manager Vacancy 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official NTPC careers portal.
